Identify S-phase progression markers in one group of cells

Source: R/progression_markers.R
analyze_one_group.Rd

Runs prepare_group_inputs(), fit_gene_gams(), classify_progression_markers() and compute_gene_curves() (on the marker genes) for one analysis group.

Usage

analyze_one_group(
  group_name,
  meta_data,
  log_expr,
  normalized_expr,
  group_by_col = "state",
  min_cells_per_group = 50L,
  min_normalized_expression = 0.1,
  min_cell_fraction = 0.2,
  fdr_threshold = 0.01,
  aic_rule = c("gam_lower", "paper_literal_gam_greater"),
  gam_basis_k = 10L,
  use_sample_covariate = FALSE,
  n_curve_points = 101L,
  n_clusters = 3L,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

group_name

Value of group_by_col to analyse.

meta_data

Output of prepare_metadata().

log_expr, normalized_expr

Gene-by-cell matrices from normalize_sparse_counts().

group_by_col

Metadata column defining the analysis groups.

min_cells_per_group

Minimum number of eligible cells; fewer is an error.

min_normalized_expression

A gene counts as expressed in a cell when its normalised expression is at least this value.

min_cell_fraction

Minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene.

fdr_threshold

FDR cut-off for the smooth term.

aic_rule

"gam_lower": the GAM must have the lower AIC; "paper_literal_gam_greater": the opposite.

gam_basis_k

Upper bound of the smooth basis dimension.

use_sample_covariate

Add sample as a covariate when it has more than one level.

n_curve_points

Number of grid points.

n_clusters

Number of curve clusters (capped at the number of curves).

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel back-end; serial by default.

verbose

Print a progress message. Default FALSE.

Value

A list with analysis_group, gam_results (all genes), marker_table (markers with a valid curve, with cluster, peak_rep_percent, late_minus_early, sorted by them and fdr), group_meta, cells, and the curves, curve_z, rep_grid, clusters, hclust, gene_order elements of compute_gene_curves().
